A Go project keeps application code in a Go module and development commands in a small Bun package.

## Generated files

```text
my-app/
├── main.go
├── go.mod
├── go.sum
├── quickgui.config.ts
├── package.json
└── README.md
```

Commit `go.sum` after resolving dependencies. Split larger apps into ordinary Go packages.

## Application entry

`main.go` starts `native.Run` and opens windows. A component is a function that returns `*ui.Element`. Return the UI you build — do not create views and ignore them.

```go
func Hello() *ui.Element {
	return ui.View().Padding(20).Gap(12).Children(
		ui.Text("Hello from Go"),
		ui.Button().Child("Continue").OnClick(func() {}),
	)
}
```

## Configuration

`entry` is the Go package to build. The config file is for the CLI; it is not loaded by the running app.

```ts
import { defineConfig } from "@quickgui/cli";

export default defineConfig({
  name: "My App",
  identifier: "com.example.my-app",
  entry: ".",
});
```

You can use `quickgui.toml` instead:

```toml
name = "My App"
identifier = "com.example.my-app"
entry = "."
```

The CLI reads `quickgui.toml` before `quickgui.config.ts`. Pass `--config configs/dev.toml` to choose a file. Quote version values, for example `version = "..."`.

Set the application icon with `icon`. Bundle extra files with `resources` and custom fonts with `fonts`. See [App Icon](/docs/go/app-icon) and [Bundled Resources](/docs/go/bundled-resources).

```ts
export default defineConfig({
  name: "My App",
  identifier: "com.example.my-app",
  entry: ".",
  icon: "assets/icon.png",
  fonts: ["assets/MyFont.ttf"],
  resources: ["assets"],
});
```

## Packages

- `github.com/egoist/quickgui/go/native` — windows and platform APIs
- `github.com/egoist/quickgui/go/ui` — components and styles
- `github.com/egoist/quickgui/go/reactive` — owners and contexts used by advanced code

`@quickgui/cli` is a development dependency. To share your own components, see [Authoring Extensions](/docs/go/extensions).

## Local development

```bash
quickgui dev
quickgui fmt
quickgui check
quickgui build
```

`dev` reloads when you change Go source or the config file.
